individual-data-points.explanation: Panel shows micrographs of MitoTracker/DsRed/GFP signals only; no averaged plot is displayed.
Bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean bars with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel is a western blot image, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Bar charts of SDH/COX signal intensity (n=15-26 per group) show only mean bars with error bars; individual data points are not shown.

FACS histograms display full cell-count distributions rather than averaged summary statistics, so individual point overlay is not applicable (also includes schematic diagrams, which are not data plots).
